name: Iri Vale
title: Relay dispatcher
dialogue: I opened a road for water carts. The concession sent drilling rigs down it. Both drivers thanked me. Find Mara in Mourning Fen, east of the city; she'll show you where the road ends.

name: Sera Quill
title: Memory witness
dialogue: We can preserve every name in a drowned village. The cooling vault will still draw water from the next one. I keep the record. I no longer call that enough.

name: Bram Cinder
title: Foundry steward
dialogue: No hand is fuel. I wrote that above the furnace while we were feeding it Cinderwood. Tovin works west of here. Ask what my promise cost his trees.

name: Ves of the Quiet
title: Null Choir listener
dialogue: We stopped the advertisements and waited for birdsong. There was none. The right to listen arrived after the thing we wanted to hear.

name: Oru
title: Lineage archivist
dialogue: Every lineage found a way to survive. Every way needed water, heat, another piece of ground. Ada keeps the northern kiln; Ilex keeps the southern cultures. Their ledgers are our family history.

name: Patch
title: Street quartermaster
dialogue: The medicine comes from the bloom. The filter keeps the bloom out of your lungs. I charge for both because the supplier charges me.

name: Mara Venn
title: Fen pump delegate
dialogue: My father drank from this well. Now I work the pump that empties it so I can buy him water. Tell me where, exactly, to stop.

name: Tovin Ash
title: Cinderwood cutter
dialogue: They paid us to restore the forest. Payment came when a tree fell. After a while we stopped asking when the restoring would begin.

name: Ada Silt
title: Steppe kiln keeper
dialogue: There is enough mineral under these roots to mend my partner. There is enough root above it to hold our well. I have measured both. The measuring hasn't helped.

name: Ilex Marr
title: Brine culture keeper
dialogue: The bloom is healthy. We are the ones coughing. I used to think those facts could not belong in the same sentence.
